situation (example wording): "mass" or "the third one" after "murders in springfield" asked which Springfield; "2" or "violent please" after "Tacoma" asked which kind of crime; "murder trends" after "tacoma pd"; "for the us" or "In Tucson Arizona" after an ask for the place
what the app does today: A typed reply to the app's own question was read as a change to the last question and usually got "I couldn't tell how this changes your last question".
proposed behavior: When the previous turn was the app's ask, a short reply (six words or fewer, not a question that stands on its own) answers it. A choice named or numbered (every word typed starts a word of exactly one button's label; "2", "the first one") is that button pressed: the question is rebuilt with the choice (the place chosen where the name was typed) and answered as a first question, with the defaults (P180-P182). Otherwise the part that was asked for is filled in from the reply: a place for "which place" (the nation for "nationwide", "for the us"), a period for "which period", a crime for "which kind of crime" (the asked question's place kept). A reply that names a choice more than one button fits, adds other words, or leads to the same ask again goes on as before.
exact default or choices offered: The button's answer, or the asked question with the reply's part.
why: Coordinator 2026-11-22 (follow-up plan item 4, approved order): a typed reply to the app's ask is the button press.
